site_name: Slay the Spire 2 · Mod Card Library
footer_blurb: Fan-made reference for modded cards, keywords, buffs, and debuffs.
footer_disclaimer: Not affiliated with Mega Crit. Card names and mechanics belong to their respective creators.
cards_meta_title: Cards List | Slay the Spire 2 Mod Cards
cards_meta_description: Browse every mod card in the archive. Filter by character, rarity, type, cost, or mod, with linked keywords, buffs, and debuffs.
cards_lede: A fan-made archive of mod cards. Filter by character, rarity, type, or cost; every underlined term in a card's text opens its rule entry.
cards_notice: This is the card list for the modded Spire. Keywords, buffs, and debuffs are shared reference pages linked directly from card text.
cards_empty_body: No card matches the current filters. Clear the filters and try again.
filter_view_beta_art_hint: Toggle beta art for all cards
card_summary: {name} is a {rarity} {type} Card for the {color}, costing {cost}.
card_obtaining_body: {name} comes from the {mod} mod and belongs to the {color} card pool.
glossary_notice: Every underlined term in a card description links to one of these entries. Use the search box or jump to a category below.
powers_meta_title: Powers | Slay the Spire 2 Mod Cards
powers_meta_description: A reference for every power in Slay the Spire 2, with its stacking type, behavior between turns, and caps.
powers_lead: Every lasting effect a card, relic, or enemy can apply. Each entry notes its stack type and what happens between turns, so a card's numbers always have a rule behind them.
keywords_meta_title: Keywords | Slay the Spire 2 Mod Cards
keywords_meta_description: Every keyword used in Slay the Spire 2 card text: Eternal, Ethereal, Exhaust, Innate, Retain, Sly, and Unplayable.
keywords_lead: The phrases that describe how a card behaves in combat. Follow any underlined term in a card description and it lands here, on the exact rule that governs it.
relics_meta_title: Relics | Slay the Spire 2 Mod Cards
relics_meta_description: Every relic in Slay the Spire 2, with its rarity, character, source, icon, and effect text, filterable by character and rarity.
relics_lead: Every relic in the base game, from starter keepsakes to ancient treasures. Filter by character and rarity; each entry shows its icon, source, and exact effect text.
relics_notice: Ancient relics can replace a starter relic or appear as upgraded versions of earlier relics.
potions_meta_title: Potions | Slay the Spire 2 Mod Cards
potions_meta_description: Every potion in Slay the Spire 2, with its rarity, character, icon, and effect text, filterable by character and rarity.
potions_lead: Every potion in the base game, from common combat aids to rare and special brews. Filter by character and rarity, then read the exact effect text.
potions_notice: Special potions cannot appear from regular potion drops.
error_default_body: The page you were looking for is not in this archive.
tools_meta_title: Tools | Slay the Spire 2 Mod Cards
tools_meta_description: Slay the Spire 2 modding tools: ID generator, card frame preview, and BBCode text preview.
tools_lead: A set of local tools for Slay the Spire 2 mod authors. Everything runs inside your browser; nothing is uploaded.
tool_id_description: Batch-generate localization entry IDs following the RitsuLib or BaseLib naming rules, with direct .cs folder import.
tool_id_meta_title: ID Generator | Slay the Spire 2 Mod Cards
tool_id_meta_description: RitsuLib and BaseLib entry ID generator with .cs folder import.
tool_id_lead: Enter a mod ID and content type to batch-generate RitsuLib localization entry IDs, or switch to BaseLib for namespace-based IDs.
tool_frame_description: Tune HSV material parameters and preview the card frame in real time, with vanilla palettes and .tres / C# output.
tool_frame_meta_title: Card Frame Preview | Slay the Spire 2 Mod Cards
tool_frame_meta_description: Preview Slay the Spire 2 card frame HSV materials and export PNG, .tres, or C# code.
tool_frame_lead: Adjust HSV parameters to preview card frame materials, pick vanilla palettes, and copy the matching .tres and C# code.
tool_text_description: Visually edit STS2 BBCode card descriptions, with colour, animation, placeholder variables, and formatters.
tool_text_meta_title: Text Preview | Slay the Spire 2 Mod Cards
tool_text_meta_description: Visual editor and live preview for STS2 BBCode card descriptions.
tool_text_lead: Edit STS2 BBCode descriptions and see the final result with colours, text animations, placeholder variables, and formatters.
